q2: SELECT beer, CASE WHEN price = min_price THEN min_price ELSE NULL END AS price, CASE WHEN price = min_price THEN bar ELSE NULL END AS bar FROM (SELECT s.beer, s.price, s.bar, (SELECT MIN(price) FROM serves WHERE serves.beer = s.beer) AS min_price FROM serves AS s) AS prices ORDER BY beer
